datasources.ui:title: Input Data Sources
datasources.ui:help: Forensic images, folders, or other data sources to process. Can specify DD, E01, VHD, ISO, AFF, and more

dname.ui:title: Display Names
dname.ui:help: Optional human-readable names for each datasource. Must match datasources order

output.ui:title: Output Folder
output.ui:help: Directory where case results will be stored

keywords.ui:title: Keywords File
keywords.ui:help: Text file with search keywords (one per line)

ocr.ui:title: OCR Categories
ocr.ui:help: Run OCR only on specific file categories or bookmarks

log.ui:title: Log File
log.ui:help: Custom location for log file output

asap.ui:title: ASAP File
asap.ui:help: Brazilian Federal Police case information file

nocontent.ui:title: Exclude from Report
nocontent.ui:help: Categories/bookmarks to exclude file contents (only thumbnails and properties exported)

blocksize.ui:title: Block Size (bytes)
blocksize.ui:help: Sector block size. Use 4096 for 4k sector drives, 512 for standard

password.ui:title: Image Passwords
password.ui:help: Passwords for encrypted volumes or images

addowner.ui:title: Index File Owner
addowner.ui:help: Extract and index file owner information (slow on network folders)

append.ui:title: Append to Existing Case
append.ui:help: Add data to an existing case instead of creating new one

continue.ui:title: Continue Processing
continue.ui:help: Resume a stopped or aborted processing run

restart.ui:title: Restart Processing
restart.ui:help: Discard failed processing and start from beginning

nogui.ui:title: Text Mode (No GUI)
nogui.ui:help: Run without progress windows, useful for headless/remote systems

nologfile.ui:title: Log to Console
nologfile.ui:help: Output logs to console instead of file

nopstattachs.ui:title: Skip PST Attachments
nopstattachs.ui:help: Do not export email attachments from PST/OST files

nolinkeditems.ui:title: Skip Linked Items
nolinkeditems.ui:help: Do not export items linked to chat conversations

portable.ui:title: Portable Case
portable.ui:help: Use relative paths so case can be moved across machines

downloadInternetData.ui:title: Download Internet Data
downloadInternetData.ui:help: Fetch current data from internet sources (e.g., WhatsApp media still available on servers)

splash.ui:title: Splash Screen Message
splash.ui:placeholder: Custom message to display on startup
